## History

As examinations approached at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) in the spring, Stella Maynard spent time anxiously preparing for tests alongside her ambitious classmates and discussing commencement attire with them.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella Maynard is an intimate friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Along with a close group of ambitious classmates, Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bond over their shared academic pursuits. As their spring examinations approach, they navigate the anxiety of testing and discuss their upcoming commencement attire together.
